experiments.name: Color Space & Linear Gradient Shift
experiments.conclusion: Gradient color space interpolation (sRGB vs Linear sRGB) causes 10.42% of total delta.

experiments.name: Solid Color Primitive Rasterization
experiments.conclusion: Pure solid color rasterization has 2.04% pixel diff due to subpixel antialiasing.

experiments.name: Subpixel Coordinate Rounding
experiments.conclusion: Integer coordinate rounding creates 0.81% boundary subpixel shifts.

experiments.name: Anti-Aliasing Edge Filtering
experiments.conclusion: Disabling AA creates 0.35% sharp-edge pixel variance.
